title: Canary Deployment 5xx Spike & Automated Rollback Analysis
businessContext: A continuous deployment pipeline promotes a new version of the GraphQL Gateway to a 10% canary weight in production. Within 3 minutes of traffic shift, alerts trigger indicating that checkout mutations are failing.
problemStatement: Analyze canary metrics (P95 latency, 5xx error rate, GraphQL mutation errors). Determine whether the error budget has been breached, make the automated rollback decision, and formulate the post-rollback triage workflow to pinpoint the failing mutation.
constraints: Rollback decision must be made within 60 seconds of error budget violation.
Canary traffic must immediately be routed back to baseline (stable) pods.
Do not disrupt active user sessions on the stable baseline.
candidateTasks: Define automated canary analysis thresholds (error rate, latency degradation, error budget burn rate).
Explain how service meshes (e.g. Istio, Argo Rollouts, AWS App Mesh) adjust traffic weights from 10% to 0%.
hints: Canary analysis should compare the canary group against the baseline group running in the same environment under identical traffic conditions.
Argo Rollouts uses Prometheus queries to continuously evaluate metrics and aborts the rollout automatically if thresholds fail.

testCases.name: Triggers automated rollback on error rate breach
testCases.explanation: Enforces rapid rollback to preserve user experience.

alternativeApproaches: Using Kayenta or Argo Rollouts AnalysisTemplate with Prometheus PromQL metrics.
commonMistakes: Comparing canary metrics against an arbitrary static number instead of the concurrently running baseline version.
Promoting the canary to 100% too fast without sufficient sample volume.
